name: panel-to-panel-route
intent: Selected comic panel scales from frozen offset to fill the stage, then resolves into a routed MISSION COMPLETE state with clear from→to labels.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Skip panel expansion; show MISSION COMPLETE route view immediately and announce route change via aria-live

acceptance: Three panels with 02 TARGET selected by default; from→to label shows panel → MISSION COMPLETE
Route expands selected panel from frozen scale 1.04 and grid offset over 740ms
Completion reveals ROUTE LOCKED / MISSION COMPLETE and aria-live announces route change
Replay resets grid, labels, and live region to idle selection
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows final route state immediately with live announcement
No network; effect stays clipped inside stage
